title: fix(app-shell): a list view's navigation.preventNavigation opens no record and draws no link face
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9N6w1Woebt4XY39p5txohNf)_

Fixes #33549

Clause-②: no — an authored key starts being honoured; no surface added
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Console 对象列表（桌面）在视图写了 `navigation.preventNavigation: true` 时，按 `mode: 'none'` 处理：点行不再打开抽屉（不写 `?recordId=`），⌘/Ctrl/中键也不开新标签页；首列不再画成记录链接，右键菜单不再有「打开」。
- 为什么改：spec 对这个键的说明是「完全禁用标准导航」，而 Console 列表此前根本不读它，作者设了也无效。其他宿主（grid、看板、日历、甘特、地图、时间线、树、plugin-view 的 ObjectView）早已遵守。
- 风险与回滚：只影响写了 `preventNavigation: true` 的视图；没写或写 `false` 的视图行为不变（对照 pin 钉住）。手机端不变。回滚即还原 `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` 中新增的一行。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewRecordNavigation.ts`（`detailNavigation` 里新增的 `preventNavigation` 一行，在手机分支之后）；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.rowOpensNothing-33317.test.tsx`（新增的 objectstack#33549 describe）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.rowOpensNothing-33317.test.tsx`，预期 15/15 通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`useObjectViewRecordNavigation` (`detailNavigation`) now resolves a view whose authored navigation carries `preventNavigation: true` to `{ mode: 'none' }`, after the phone branch and before any authored mode is read. Everything downstream already keys on that resolved mode, so the one line folds the flag into every reader at once:

- `handleRowClick` returns on `none`: a plain click writes no `?recordId=`, and a ⌘, Ctrl or middle click opens no tab (the console's own `none` rule).
- `rowOpensRecord: navOverlay.mode !== 'none'` (`ObjectView`) is `false`, so the grid draws the record-link column as plain text and the right-click menu offers no Open items. The row's `list_item` actions stay.
- The row's `↗` (open as page) and the reader's Open records preference are drawer-only, so they are not offered either.

Hosts measured (who reads `navigation.preventNavigation` on `main` at `385ea1cc`):

| Host | Before | This PR |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Console object list, `@object-ui/app-shell` `ObjectView` via `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` | ignored on `drawer` (opened the drawer); a `page` view's plain click was already inert through `useNavigationOverlay`, but its link face, Open items and modifier-click tab stayed | **changed**: resolves to `none` |
| `@object-ui/plugin-view` `ObjectView` `handleRowClick` | honoured, modifier click included | unchanged |
| `@object-ui/plugin-grid` `ObjectGrid` (`opens` in the row context menu) | honoured | unchanged |
| `useNavigationOverlay` (`@object-ui/react`): kanban, calendar, gantt, map, timeline, tree | honoured (each has a pin) | unchanged |
| `ObjectDataPage` | reads no view navigation: hard-codes `{ mode: 'drawer' }` | unchanged (no authored view on that page) |
| `InterfaceListPage` | reads the page's `recordAction`, not the source view's `navigation` block (it ignores the view's `mode` too) | unchanged |

Phone face (out of scope, measured, not changed): on a phone, `detailNavigation` answers `deriveRecordSurface(objectDef, { viewport: 'mobile' })` before reading anything authored. A throwaway hook probe on head `2b09572e` (deleted, not committed) gave, for a view `{ mode: 'drawer', preventNavigation: true }`: phone ⇒ resolved mode `page`, and a row tap calls `navigate('record/r-2')` (the record page opens); desktop ⇒ resolved mode `none`, no navigate and no search-param write. Whether a phone tap should honour an authored "no navigation" is the open maintainer decision #33719.

Docs: `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-grid.mdx` and `plugin-list.mdx` (which name the console's `rowOpensRecord={false}` cases) and `plugin-view.mdx` (the Console's record drawer section) now say the flag resolves the same way.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in the existing harness `ObjectView.rowOpensNothing-33317.test.tsx` (real `ObjectView`, real `ListView` grid; a `LocationProbe` added beside the list route reads `?recordId=`). No forced test edits: the harness's `mountList` / `objectsWith` take a widened `navigation` type and the route element gains the probe; every pre-existing case is unchanged and green.

- `drawer` + `preventNavigation: true`: a plain row click writes no `?recordId=` and stays on the list, no tab.
- the same: ⌘ / Ctrl / middle click opens no tab.
- the same: name cell plain text, no `primary-field-link`, right-click menu has no Open items, keeps Revoke.
- `page` + `preventNavigation: true`: no link face; a click stays on the list.
- CONTROL: `drawer` + `preventNavigation: false`: link face, and a row click writes `?recordId=c1`.
- CONTROL: `drawer` with the flag absent: a row click writes `?recordId=c1`.

<details><summary>Red-first, green, ablation</summary>

- Red-first (pins on `385ea1cc` code, before the fix): `Tests 4 failed | 11 passed (15)`; the four new non-CONTROL cases failed, both CONTROLs passed.
- Green on `2b09572e`: the harness plus the three neighbouring record-navigation files (`ObjectView.cardFacesOpenNothing-33548`, `objectViewRecordNavigation.listRows-27524`, `objectViewRecordNavigation.phonePush-29074`): `Test Files 4 passed (4) · Tests 42 passed (42)`.
- Ablation (committed fix first, `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` of the anchor `if (authored?.preventNavigation) return { mode: 'none' };`): `anchor 1 -> 0, blob e05a3a1b4cf4 -> 078c53e3487d`, run `Tests 4 failed | 11 passed (15)` (the same four), restore blob `e05a3a1b…` = HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty. The tests import the module by relative path (source, no `dist/`), so no rebuild leg applies.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- A `?recordId=` link opened on a list whose view resolves to `none` (authored `none`, and now `preventNavigation: true`) still opens the drawer through the URL-sync effect: only a list-only object (`servesRecordRead`) refuses the link. This PR keeps `preventNavigation` identical to an authored `none`, so it changes nothing there; whether a deep link should open a record on a view that opens none is not asked by this card. carrier: none — noted, not filed.
